title: Folhas de Operação — Dedicado
prompt:
Create a high-fidelity 1600x1000 desktop dashboard screenshot for GO Itaim Dashboard Geral, page Dedicado. Follow the selected Folhas de Operação reference: warm ivory paper, clean graphite type, cobalt navigation and controls, small chrome-yellow section tabs, fine rules, compact but breathable tables, restrained translucent panels. No browser chrome/device frame. Preserve product name, logo, existing content terms and functions.

Persistent full sidebar with exact groups: Principal (Visão Geral, Análise, UTR, Comparação); Operacional (Entregadores, Valores, Prioridade | Promo, Evolução, Dedicado selected); Marketing (Operacional Marketing, Marketing). Header breadcrumb "Operacional › Dedicado". Centered header ticker has green refresh icon, "Sincronizado", horizontal clipped sequence "Guarulhos 29/09 · Manaus 28/09 · São Paulo 2.0 27/09 · Sorocaba 26/09" with fades showing scroll; theme and user on right. Sample city/date pairs only.

Immediately beneath header, render the complete global filter bar, clearly legible and separate from ticker: row one "Período", "Ano/Semana" selected / "Intervalo", "Ano 2026", multi-select "Semana 05, 06, 07"; row two individual controls "Praça Todas", "Sub praça Todas", "Origem Todas", "Turno Todos", "Limpar".

Main heading "DEDICADO", description "Visão separada para restaurantes e origens, com entregadores, resumo por origem e matriz Dia x Origem no mesmo lugar." Button "Baixar Excel". Show the real five sub-tabs in one strip: "Dashboard" selected, "Entregadores", "Ranking", "Resumo por Origem", "Dia x Origem". Summary cards with exact labels "Entregadores", "Origens", "Ofertadas", "Aceitas", "Rejeitadas", "Horas". Below a large section "Top origens" with two-column arrangement of origin panels, each showing "Aderência", "Ofertadas", "Aceitas", "Completadas", "Horas". All values are illustrative placeholders. No unsupported restaurant imagery; use text labels and simple icon marks. Keep all global filter controls at top visible.
demoData: Indicadores e origens demonstrativos; não usar como dados do Supabase.
